_comment: Template for gtc_demo/artifacts/gallery_sources.json. Copy this file to that path and replace each image_path with a LOCAL path to the corresponding IU Chest X-Ray PNG you obtained from the official OpenI / Indiana University source (see scripts/prepare_local_iu_assets.py). The real gallery_sources.json is gitignored because it contains absolute local paths to source dataset images, which are NOT redistributed here. Labels are display captions only.
